subject: Computer Science
title: Virtual Memory and Paging
lines: Virtual memory separates logical memory from physical memory.
Physical memory is partitioned into frames, logical memory into pages.
A page table translates page numbers to physical frame numbers.
hard_negatives: Pages and frames must always be identical in size (unusual phrasing but correct).

subject: Computer Science
title: Page Replacement FIFO and LRU
lines: Page replacement occurs during a page fault when no frames are free.
FIFO replaces the oldest page in memory, which can suffer from Belady's anomaly.
LRU replaces the page that has not been referenced for the longest duration.

subject: Computer Science
title: Four Conditions of Deadlock
lines: Deadlock requires mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait.
No preemption means resources cannot be forcibly confiscated.
Breaking circular wait prevents deadlocks by ordering resource acquisition.

subject: Computer Science
title: Binary Search Tree Operations
lines: In a BST, keys in the left subtree are smaller than the node's key.
Keys in the right subtree are greater than the node's key.
Balanced search trees guarantee logarithmic O(log n) time complexity.

subject: Computer Science
title: Dynamic Programming Paradigms
lines: Dynamic programming breaks complex problems into overlapping subproblems.
Memoization is a top-down approach that caches recursive subproblem results.
Tabulation solves subproblems iteratively from the bottom up.

subject: Physics
title: Newton's Second and Third Laws
lines: Net force equals mass times acceleration: F_net = m * a.
Action and reaction forces are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction.
Action and reaction forces act on distinct bodies, never cancelling each other.
hard_negatives: Action and reaction forces cannot cancel because they act on different objects.

subject: Physics
title: Work and Kinetic Energy Theorem
lines: Net work done on an object equals its change in kinetic energy.
Conservative forces conserve total mechanical energy E = K + U.
Non-conservative forces convert mechanical energy into thermal dissipation.

subject: Physics
title: First and Second Laws of Thermodynamics
lines: Delta U = Q - W expresses the conservation of internal energy.
Entropy in an isolated thermodynamic system cannot decrease over time.
Heat does not flow spontaneously from a cooler object to a hotter object.

subject: Chemistry
title: Enthalpy and Calorimetry
lines: Enthalpy is defined as H = U + P*V.
Exothermic reactions release heat and have negative Delta H.
Endothermic reactions absorb heat from their surroundings with Delta H > 0.

subject: Chemistry
title: Gibbs Free Energy and Equilibrium
lines: Gibbs free energy change Delta G equals Delta H minus T * Delta S.
A reaction is spontaneous when Delta G is less than zero.
Standard free energy satisfies Delta G^circ = -R * T * ln(K).

subject: Biology
title: Cellular Respiration and Glycolysis
lines: Glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm and breaks glucose into two pyruvates.
Net yield of glycolysis is 2 ATP and 2 NADH per glucose molecule.
Pyruvate oxidation produces Acetyl-CoA which enters the citric acid cycle.

subject: Biology
title: DNA Replication Mechanism
lines: DNA replication is semiconservative with one parental and one daughter strand.
DNA polymerase III synthesizes new DNA strictly in the 5' to 3' direction.
The lagging strand is synthesized as Okazaki fragments and sealed by ligase.
hard_negatives: DNA polymerase cannot synthesize 3' to 5' under any known biological circumstances.

subject: Computer Science
title: Process Scheduling Algorithms
lines: Preemptive schedulers can interrupt executing processes to switch contexts.
Round robin scheduling allocates a fixed time slice to each runnable thread.
Shortest job first minimizes average waiting time across all workloads.

subject: Physics
title: Simple Harmonic Motion
lines: In simple harmonic motion, restoring force is directly proportional to displacement: F = -k * x.
Total mechanical energy in an undamped oscillator remains constant over all cycles.
The oscillation period of a mass-spring system depends on mass and spring constant.

subject: Computer Science
title: Memory Paging Inaccuracies
lines: Virtual memory allows addresses to be contiguous in physical memory.
Page faults occur when an address is already loaded into physical RAM.
FIFO page replacement is immune to Belady's anomaly because it is optimal.

subject: Computer Science
title: Deadlock Preemption Confusion
lines: Deadlock can occur with only three Coffman conditions without circular wait.
Preemption means resources can never be taken away from any holding process.
Mutual exclusion requires all resources in the system to be shared freely.

subject: Physics
title: Newtonian Force Pairs Inversion
lines: Newton's third law force pairs act on the exact same single object.
Action and reaction forces cancel out completely so no object can ever accelerate.
Net force on an object moving at constant velocity must be non-zero.

lines: In an isolated system, total entropy always decreases spontaneously over time.
Heat naturally flows from colder objects into warmer objects without work input.
Delta U equals heat added plus work done by the system: Delta U = Q + W.

title: Gibbs Energy Spontaneity Reversal
lines: A chemical reaction is spontaneous when Delta G is positive.
Exothermic reactions absorb heat from the surroundings and have positive Delta H.
At chemical dynamic equilibrium, Delta G is at its maximum positive value.

lines: DNA polymerase III synthesizes new daughter strands in the 3' to 5' direction.
Glycolysis takes place inside the mitochondrial matrix in all cells.

subject: Computer Science
title: Code Only Python Binary Search
lines: def binary_search(arr, target):
low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
while low <= high:
mid = (low + high) // 2
if arr[mid] == target: return mid
elif arr[mid] < target: low = mid + 1
else: high = mid - 1
return -1

subject: Medieval History
title: Treaty of Westphalia 1648
lines: The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 concluded the Thirty Years War in the Holy Roman Empire.
It established the doctrine of state sovereignty and cuius regio, eius religio.
Diplomatic delegations negotiated in the Westphalian cities of Munster and Osnabruck.

subject: Art History
title: Baroque Chiaroscuro and Caravaggio
lines: Caravaggio pioneered dramatic tenebrism and chiaroscuro in Baroque oil painting.
The Calling of Saint Matthew employs intense directional lighting against dark shadows.
Naturalistic depiction of biblical figures rejected idealized Mannerist conventions.

subject: Ancient Archaeology
title: Linear B Decipherment at Knossos
lines: Michael Ventris deciphered Linear B tablets found at Knossos and Pylos in 1952.
The script was confirmed to represent an archaic dialect of Mycenaean Greek.
Linear B functioned primarily for palace administrative accounts and agricultural censuses.
